summary: Defined and implemented lossless text coordinates for the current Search sources. File-backed readers now preserve original-byte offsets and lengths alongside explicit UTF-16 columns and lengths; line sinks map LF-based physical records, including CRLF, lone-CR and EOF boundaries, while injected decoded readers retain null byte coordinates.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search coordinate/matcher/reader/sink/schema implementation, Search tests and related Search documentation were changed. Existing two-argument SQL constructor metadata remains unchanged; no sibling repository, release, publication, installation or raw-byte source was modified.

coordinatePolicy.byteMapping: Strict file-backed UTF-8 and UTF-16 readers map decoded code units to contiguous original-byte spans. UTF-8 supplementary scalar surrogate pairs share one four-byte range; a partial-scalar match remains nullable rather than receiving a fabricated byte span.
coordinatePolicy.lineBoundaries: LF is the physical boundary; CRLF is retained in the completed line and starts the next line after LF; lone CR remains line content; a final line is completed at successful EOF without a terminator.
coordinatePolicy.unmappedReaders: Injected already-decoded TextReader instances retain line and UTF-16 coordinates but expose null original-byte coordinates.
coordinatePolicy.numericModel: All source offsets, lengths, line numbers and columns use signed 64-bit values with checked arithmetic.
